text_to_image_prompt: Photographic six-angle head reference sheet of an adult woman aged thirty-eight, brown wavy hair loosely tied up with face-framing wisps, green eyes, light freckles, gently mature facial details, cream knitted sweater and blue-gray pinstriped apron.  Exactly six equal head-and-shoulder panels in a 3-column by 2-row grid, same person and hairstyle in every panel. Top row: direct centered FRONT, left three-quarter 45 degrees, right three-quarter 45 degrees. Bottom row: true LEFT profile 90 degrees, true RIGHT profile 90 degrees, BACK of head 180 degrees. Eye-level camera in ALL panels, upright head, neutral closed lips, level eye line, anatomically balanced face, no head tilt, preserve skull and jaw. Full hair visible with whitespace. Identical cream-white seamless background and bright soft frontal daylight, realistic skin pores and textile texture, low contrast. No text, no labels, no duplicated angles.
